maddeler.e:
انجليت (form VII)
# اِنْجَلَيْتُ (injalaytu) /in.d͡ʒa.laj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
# اِنْجَلَيْتَ (injalayta) /in.d͡ʒa.laj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
# اِنْجَلَيْتِ (injalayti) /in.d͡ʒa.laj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
